DOVAKIN'S Plan

Reskins against Nurgle, Khorne, High Elves, Dark Elves and Tzeentch Warriors

< Concept >

---------------------------------------------------- Proceeding ----------------------------------------------------

Warrior of Asuryan: nobility, fantasy

Warrior of Nugle: Grotesque, necrophilia

-------------------------------------------- Appointment --------------------------------------------

warrior of Khaine: cruel, dark fantasy

Warrior of Khorne: gore, muscle

Warrior of Tzeentch: witch, psychopath, magic armor

-------------------------------------------- completed --------------------------------------------

Warrior of Slaanesh's concept was a masochist and a sadist.
